dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses ORCDBMAIN call pattern and MCP framework typical of JMA ORCA system.

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claims) software - disease name code list screen handler (ORCGX100)
purpose.summary: This program is a screen/window controller within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It handles the LINK event by calling an initialisation section, and for all other events navigates back to the previous page by setting MCP window routing fields and calling ORCDBMAIN with PUTWINDOW function. It manages SPA (scratchpad area) state across screen transitions.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (18 copybooks) for screen layout and linkage areas
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple COPY-defined areas (MCPAREA, ORCA-SPA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA)
EVALUATE on MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT for event-driven screen navigation
Japanese comments encoded in EUC-JP (latin-1 decoded as mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary ORCDBMAIN DB abstraction
grpsys label on CALL line (non-standard label in area A)
verdict.notes: Japanese comments are EUC-JP encoded, displayed as mojibake under latin-1 decoding. The file is part of the open-source JMA ORCA system. The 'grpsys' token on the CALL line appears to be a group/section label artifact in area A, not standard COBOL but common in this codebase. Only 1 PIC clause visible in source - most data definitions are in copybooks.
